attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determines if corporation must file Washington B&O tax return. Washington B&O tax nexus: Physical presence (office, employees, property) or Economic nexus ($100,000 or more in Washington receipts OR 200+ transactions). Note: No minimum filing threshold - any taxable activity requires filing. References: RCW 82.04.067 (Nexus), WAC 458-20-193 (Interstate Sales), WAC 458-20-19401 (Economic Nexus).

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "WA" streq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.state_code get "WA" streq and

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus - B&O tax filing required; Physical nexus established - B&O tax filing required (calculated by table 51080)
action_details.action_postfix: "Washington B&O tax filing required due to physical presence. Physical presence includes: office/business in WA, employees in WA, tangible property in WA, inventory in WA, or regular solicitation in WA. References: RCW 82.04.067 (Nexus), WAC 458-20-193 (Interstate Sales), WAC 458-20-19401 (Economic Nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus - B&O tax filing required
action_details.action_dsl: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_postfix: "Washington B&O tax filing required due to economic nexus. Economic nexus threshold (either): $100,000 or more in Washington receipts (gross revenue), OR 200 or more separate transactions in Washington. Washington adopted economic nexus following South Dakota v. Wayfair (2018). References: RCW 82.04.067 (Economic Nexus), WAC 458-20-19401 (Economic Nexus Rules), South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wa_bo_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Washington nexus - no B&O tax filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Washington-sourced gross receipts for B&O tax using apportionment. Washington B&O tax is based on gross receipts from activities in Washington including: sales of tangible property delivered in WA, services performed in WA, royalties from WA sources, rental income from property located in WA. Uses single-factor receipts apportionment (market-based sourcing). References: RCW 82.04.460 (Apportionment), WAC 458-20-19402 (Single-Factor Receipts), WAC 458-20-14601 (Service Activities).

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate WA gross receipts; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

condition_details.condition_comment: Has calculated apportionment percentage to Washington

action_details.action_comment: Calculate WA gross receipts using apportionment; Calculate WA-sourced gross receipts using apportionment percentage
action_details.action_postfix: revenue.total_revenue get apportionment.apportionment_percentage get mul /result.wa_gross_receipts xdef "Washington gross receipts calculation for B&O tax using market-based sourcing. Reference: RCW 82.04.460" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix: revenue.total_revenue get /result.wa_gross_receipts xdef "No apportionment percentage - treating all receipts as Washington-sourced." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no WA gross receipts; No Washington nexus - no gross receipts attributed to Washington
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wa_gross_receipts xdef "No Washington nexus - no gross receipts attributed to Washington." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determines the business classification for B&O tax rate purposes. Washington B&O tax rates vary by business activity: Service/Other Activities (0.484%), Retailing (0.471%), Wholesaling (0.484%), Manufacturing (0.484%), Professional Services (0.484%), Financial Business (1.5%). Note: In practice, businesses may have multiple classifications and must report each separately. References: RCW 82.04.240 (Manufacturing), RCW 82.04.250 (Retailing), RCW 82.04.290 (Service/Financial).

Retailing includes sales of tangible personal property to consumers for consumption or use (not for resale). References: RCW 82.04.250 (Retailing), RCW 82.04.470 (Retailing B&O Tax Rate)" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates the Washington small business B&O tax credit. Small Business B&O Credit: Available for businesses with gross revenue under $250,000, credit amount varies based on total revenue and phases out as revenue increases, reduces B&O tax liability (can reduce to zero but not create refund). Maximum credit approximately $100-120 per month ($1,200-1,440 annually). References: RCW 82.04.4451 (Small Business B&O Credit), WAC 458-20-104 (Small Business Tax Relief).

condition_details.condition_comment: Total revenue below $250K small business threshold; revenue.total_revenue < result.wa_small_business_credit_threshold
Has Washington gross receipts subject to B&O tax

action_details.action_comment: Qualifies for small business B&O credit; Calculate small business credit (phases out as revenue approaches $250K)
action_details.action_postfix: true /result.wa_qualifies_for_small_business_credit xdef 1.0 revenue.total_revenue get result.wa_small_business_credit_threshold get div sub /credit_percentage xdef 1440.0 /max_annual_credit xdef max_annual_credit get credit_percentage get mul /result.wa_small_business_credit xdef "Washington Small Business B&O Tax Credit applied. Revenue under $250K. Reference: RCW 82.04.4451" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No credit - revenue exceeds threshold; No small business credit - gross revenue exceeds $250,000 threshold
action_details.action_postfix: false /result.wa_qualifies_for_small_business_credit xdef 0.0 /result.wa_small_business_credit xdef "No small business credit - gross revenue exceeds $250,000 threshold." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No credit - no WA gross receipts; No small business credit - no Washington gross receipts to apply credit against
action_details.action_postfix: false /result.wa_qualifies_for_small_business_credit xdef 0.0 /result.wa_small_business_credit xdef "No small business credit - no Washington gross receipts." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates final Washington Business and Occupation (B&O) tax liability. IMPORTANT: Washington has NO corporate income tax. The B&O tax is a gross receipts tax, NOT an income tax. Process: 1) Calculate WA-sourced gross receipts (table 51020), 2) Determine business classification rate (table 51040), 3) Calculate B&O tax = gross receipts × B&O rate, 4) Apply small business credit (table 51060), 5) Apply other credits (high tech, aerospace), 6) Calculate refund or amount owed. Key Differences from Income Tax: Based on GROSS RECEIPTS (revenue) not net income, no deductions for expenses/COGS/payroll, much lower rates (under 1.5%) but applies to gross revenue, must be paid even if business operates at a loss. References: RCW 82.04 (Business and Occupation Tax), WAC 458-20-104 (Small Business Tax Relief), Form ETA (Combined Excise Tax Return).

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe B&O tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate B&O tax with all credits; Calculate Washington B&O tax on gross receipts and apply all credits
action_details.action_postfix: result.wa_gross_receipts get result.wa_bo_tax_rate get mul /result.wa_bo_tax xdef result.wa_bo_tax get result.wa_small_business_credit get sub 0.0 max /result.wa_bo_tax xdef result.wa_bo_tax get result.wa_high_tech_credit get sub 0.0 max /result.wa_bo_tax xdef result.wa_bo_tax get result.wa_aerospace_credit get sub 0.0 max /result.wa_bo_tax xdef result.wa_bo_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /result.wa_bo_tax xdef result.wa_bo_tax get /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "Washington B&O Tax calculated. Gross receipts tax, NOT income tax. Reference: RCW 82.04" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no B&O tax; No Washington nexus - no B&O tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wa_bo_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Washington nexus - no B&O tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wa_bo_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Washington gross receipts - no B&O tax liability. Filing may still be required to report no tax due." job.audit_trail swap addto
